Building Personal Projects with a Purpose

I'm a mechanical engineering student at Duke University, currently working toward an aerospace specialization. In my free time outside of class, I like to build personal engineering projects.

These projects help me improve my CAD abilities, electrical work, mechanical components, physics, and problem-solving, all while having fun and doing what I love. I'm always open to learning new things or improving on the old.
